description: 4-stage print-in-place telescoping rod. Tubes numbered from outside (1) to inside (4); files parts/parts_N.stl. All coordinates in the model.stl frame; as-printed (collapsed) pose = travel 0.

limits.extension_stop: 45deg top cone of collar on tube2 (r 9.4->10.7) contacts 45deg underside of top lip of tube1 (r 10.4..11.2 overlap 0.8 mm radial) at +84.55
limits.collapse_stop: 45deg underside of collar on tube2 contacts 45deg top of bottom lip of tube1 at -0.85 (print-state normal gap 0.60 mm)

limits.extension_stop: collar on tube3 contacts top lip of tube2 at +87.55
limits.collapse_stop: collar on tube3 contacts bottom lip of tube2 at -0.85

limits.extension_stop: collar on tube4 contacts top lip of tube3 at +90.55
limits.collapse_stop: collar on tube4 contacts bottom lip of tube3 at -0.85

chain: tube1 (base, fixed) -> J1 -> tube2 -> J2 -> tube3 -> J3 -> tube4
